answer: To resist Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must lock $25,000 in ETH bonds into a smart contract. Second, the agent generates a unique, hardware-signed identity using a secure enclave. Third, the network verifies this cryptographic proof alongside the bond before any tasking occurs. An attacker faces a massive cost of $25,000 in bonds and 48 hours of hardware provisioning per fake identity. This mechanism acts as a sturdy trellis, supporting the growth of a digital orchard as agents climb toward the economic summit.
